description:
Here's a description of the provided plot, following the requested guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between training steps and bits per character (BPC) for two different models. The x-axis is labeled “Training Steps (x10³)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50,000, with tick labels at intervals of 10,000. The y-axis is labeled “BPC” and has a linear scale ranging from 1.1 to 2.2, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. A black line with circular markers represents “SMoE Validating”, starting at approximately 1.7 BPC at 0 training steps and decreasing to approximately 1.12 BPC at 50,000 training steps, with a relatively steady trend between 20,000 and 40,000 training steps where the value fluctuates between 1.13 and 1.16 BPC. A magenta line with no markers represents “SimSMoE Validating”, beginning at approximately 2.1 BPC at 0 training steps and decreasing to approximately 1.11 BPC at 50,000 training steps, with a similar steady trend between 20,000 and 40,000 training steps where the value fluctuates between 1.12 and 1.15 BPC.
